name: Hebron
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Palestine Land Authority identifies the authority as responsible for property registration, real-property information, surveying and development of the national geographic information system; its official Hebron office is listed. The official Geocortex viewer labels the parcel layer as PLA-sourced registered parcels.
technicalBlocker: Anonymous parcel geometry was verified through the public viewer's service route, but runtime adapter admission remains held pending independent serial review. The viewer-issued public token is not retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Palestine Land Authority registered-parcel layer exposed by the GeoMOLG Geocortex ParcelSearch viewer; service full extent is Palestine Grid EPSG:28191.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three safe ID+polygon records returned from a bounded 3 km envelope centered on the exact WUP point; this proves an open sample near Hebron, not citywide completeness.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A real public parcel source is present, but runtime enablement is intentionally held until a serial reviewer independently qualifies endpoint stability, token lifecycle, schema/CRS handling and coverage semantics.

portals.name: GeoMOLG Geocortex ParcelSearch
portals.operator: GeoMOLG viewer exposing a Palestine Land Authority parcel layer
portals.observation: Viewer HTML lists Parcels_All_PLA, layer 0 `Parcels -Registered- Source: PLA`, native primary key OBJECTID, polygon feature type, and Palestine_1923_Palestine_Grid WKID 28191.
portals.requestOutcome: Viewer page returned HTTP 200. Geocortex REST configuration returned the service URL and a viewer-issued public token; token value redacted from all retained evidence.

portals.name: Palestine Land Authority
portals.observation: Official authority material describes property registration, real-property information, surveying and GIS modernization; an official Hebron office is listed. This is custody evidence, distinct from the GeoMOLG service implementation.
portals.requestOutcome: Official pages were reachable through web discovery; no owner or titleholder information was requested.

requests.assessment: Viewer/configuration page; exposed service route, parcel layer, native key and EPSG:28191.
Viewer configuration; public token present and redacted, service URL confirmed.
Without the viewer token the service returned ArcGIS error 499 Token Required; this is an expected credentialed-service route, not a login wall.

With the viewer-issued public token, browser headers, viewer Referer, inSR=28191 and outSR=4326, bounded 3 km envelope query returned 3 Polygon features; requested outFields=OBJECTID only. Raw unchanged response is in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/hebron/hebron-parcel-response-3km.json.
A tighter 800 m envelope around the exact transformed WUP point returned an empty feature list; this is not treated as absence.

source.name: Parcels_All_PLA / Parcels -Registered-

source.serviceType: ArcGIS REST MapServer FeatureLayer query exposed through official/public Geocortex viewer configuration
source.outputCrs: EPSG:4326 for retained response; native service/viewer CRS EPSG:28191 (Palestine_1923_Palestine_Grid)
source.nativeIdEvidence: Geocortex layer metadata marks OBJECTID as primaryKeyField and the ArcGIS response repeats the same native identity as feature id and OBJECTID property.
source.operatorNote: Viewer configuration contained a public token; its value is intentionally not retained. Composite key not needed because OBJECTID is documented as the layer primary key.
